items.headline: Danny Boyle Confirms Use Of AI In New Movie 'Ink'
items.excerpt: "There's about 30 seconds of it in our movie," the Oscar winner said about using generative AI to bring the Kray twins and Margaret Thatcher to life on screen in old photographs.

items.headline: Tamar AI's TapNow Brings AI-Native Filmmaking Platform to Venice Production Bridge
items.excerpt: TapNow, HappyHorse and Glanze head to the Venice Production Bridge as Palo Alto's Tamar AI bets its AI-native 'creative operating system' can turn small teams into global studios.

items.headline: Google DeepMind, Amazon Web Services, Kling AI Join Busan Market Tech Program InnoAsia
items.excerpt: Busan's Asian Contents & Film Market unveiled its InnoAsia lineup, pairing global AI production-tech firms with seven Korean startups plus a branded-film contest.

items.headline: Nikola Todorovic on the Latest Developments in Autodesk's Flow Studio
items.excerpt: How Flow Studio's new 3D Editor + Canvas works: interactive 3D scene construction married to generative 2D video models, so prompt-based images gain real camera and blocking control.

items.headline: One of the New Categories at the VES Awards Is 'Outstanding In-Camera Effects in a Photoreal Project'
items.excerpt: The Visual Effects Society announced new categories and rule updates for its awards, including one that singles out effects achieved practically in camera rather than generated in post.

items.headline: Nice Touch Launches V2 of Its AI Edit Assistant for Pro Editors
items.excerpt: Nice Touch's V2 is a full rebuild shaped by more than 300 conversations with editors, producers and studio owners; the app analyzes a project and assists professional post teams.

items.headline: Avid Media Composer 2026.8 at IBC: Agentic Workflows, More
items.excerpt: At IBC, Avid shows the latest Media Composer with deeper Content Core integration and expanded agentic workflow intelligence, plus new collaboration and storage capabilities.

items.headline: EditShare Updates at IBC Include EFS, Flow AI and MediaSilo
items.excerpt: EditShare brings GPU-powered Flow AI processing into its storage nodes at IBC 2026, with multilingual transcription and new all-in-one Ultimate EFS configurations.

items.headline: The Power of On-Premises Open-Weight Models for Generative Media
items.excerpt: A look at adopting generative AI open-weight models in-house, and how they can improve workflow stability, security, cost predictability and delivery efficiency for studios.

items.headline: Crafty Apes CEO Alana Newell
items.excerpt: From compositor to CEO: Alana Newell on where Crafty Apes is heading as VFX pipelines absorb new AI tooling and studios rethink how shots get made.

items.headline: Nura Studios Opens Showcraft AI Production Platform to the Public
items.excerpt: Showcraft takes a story from script, shot list or concept through storyboard, animatic, animation and final edit in one connected environment; tools already used on 'Rainbow Hollow' and 'Astro Burn' are now public.

items.headline: Eddie AI Launches an Agent Marketplace of Editing Agents Built on Great Filmmakers
items.excerpt: Eddie AI's new Agent Marketplace offers editing agents modeled on the sensibilities of well-known filmmakers, letting editors run a cut past a Nolan-flavored assistant.

items.headline: Caira Gets AI Generative Video Editing Feature
items.excerpt: Camera Intelligence's Caira camera adds Gemini Omni and Runway Aleph-powered generative editing, letting shooters relight, reframe and extend footage they've already captured.

items.headline: Over 500 Free Maya Animation Tools Are Now Available in One Place
items.excerpt: Animo v10.0 collects more than 500 free Maya animation tools into a single library, putting a large chunk of the animator's daily toolkit behind one install.

items.headline: This AI Workflow Flips Filmmaking on Its Head
items.excerpt: Curious Refuge walks through a workflow that uses existing footage to generate new camera coverage — reframing shots that were never actually captured that way on set.

items.headline: Introducing GWM Worlds 2, a Playable World Model
items.excerpt: Runway's latest General World Model generates interactive real-time simulations in continuous 720p video at 24 fps with 48kHz audio, letting creators define environment, subjects and style.

items.headline: What Makes a Good ROTOSCOPE?
items.excerpt: Emmy-nominated VFX supervisor Marion Spates breaks down what separates a good roto from a bad one — the craft judgment that automated matting tools still have to clear.
